title: Agent Lifecycle Run Plan Issue Request
description: ALR-1102 Route 3 request (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:626-660): POST .../agent-lifecycle/run-plans. Issues a nonce-bound, content-free run plan against an already-minted AgentRevision (Route 1) and MeasurementContract (Route 2) -- this route never creates either. schema_version is a closed wire-version discriminator, not a product claim. The request carries no denominator, no completeness field, and no raw content: expected_count is computed exclusively from the already-accepted immutable contract membership by Backend, never supplied here. The optional experiment_run_ref is provenance only (never the lifecycle parent or identity) and is resolved same-scope by Backend; this is the only Part 1 writer of that field. `Idempotency-Key` (required, scoped to this route, same durable-replay mechanism as Routes 1-2) is a request HEADER, not a JSON body field, and is therefore out of this document's scope -- a missing/malformed header is `service_invalid` (corpus cases `run_plan_issue_missing_idempotency_key`, `idempotency_key_malformed_pattern_rejected`), decided at the route layer, not by a generic JSON Schema validator (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:971). `StableOpaqueRef`/`TypedOpaqueRef` are defined once here (the first Part 1 route in dependency order that needs both ref shapes) and are the canonical shared definitions the sibling agent_lifecycle_run_plan_issue_response_schema.json and agent_lifecycle_receipt_submit_*_schema.json files in this directory $ref cross-file, so the shapes are not duplicated four times.

schema_version.description: Closed public wire-version discriminator (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:272); never a product/version claim.

agent_revision_ref.description: Must already exist (minted by Route 1) and resolve in the authenticated tenant/project/owner scope; this route never creates a revision (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:639).

measurement_contract_ref.description: Must already exist (minted by Route 2) and resolve to one immutable Backend-held expected universe in the same scope (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:640).

experiment_run_ref.description: Optional provenance only, never the lifecycle parent or identity (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:641, :112). No version_id: StableOpaqueRef names a longitudinal Backend resource lifecycle does not mint or version.

OpaqueRefId.description: Not a name, digest, tenant id, or content-derived public capability (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:285, :294-295).

kind.description: Part 1 StableOpaqueRef kinds only (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:284); each use site further constrains this to its exact kind.

StableOpaqueRef.description: Names a longitudinal, non-versioned resource that outlives any single snapshot of it (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:280). Has no version_id field at all -- additionalProperties:false rejects one (corpus case typed_ref_stable_kind_includes_version_id, PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:287, :1058).

kind.description: Full Part 1 TypedOpaqueRef kind vocabulary (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:293), including reserved kinds with no Part 1 producer; each use site further constrains this to its exact kind.

version_id.description: Identifies one immutable version; never 'latest' (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:295). version_id==id is required for every immutable-snapshot kind in this beta contract (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:299), but that cross-field equality is service_invalid, not schema-decidable (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:971, corpus case typed_ref_immutable_kind_version_id_mismatch) -- proved by a Backend-side test, not this schema.

TypedOpaqueRef.description: Content-free object naming one immutable, once-minted snapshot (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:289).
